reviews.title: Pure poetry in fabric!
reviews.comment: I ordered this tiered mauve dress for my sister's sangeet and the compliments were endless. The fabric has such an ethereal drape and the sequin work is so subtle and tasteful, not loud at all. The fit in size M was perfection.

reviews.title: Stunning craftsmanship
reviews.comment: The packaging with the signature Muskan's Stitching box and scented butter paper was an experience in itself. The layers flow like water when you walk.

reviews.title: Heirloom quality piece
reviews.comment: The Chanderi silk is so soft and the antique zardozi work looks like a designer couture piece worth lakhs. Truly impressed with Muskan's Stitching's quality.

reviews.title: The espresso velvet is magnificent
reviews.comment: Wore this for an evening reception in Delhi winter. Keeps you comfortably warm while looking like royalty. The scalloped dupatta is exceptional.

reviews.title: Breathtaking shade of royal purple!
reviews.comment: The color in person is even more majestic than the photos. The gold boota embroidery glistens delicately and the fit of the trousers and sheer dupatta drape is impeccable. Wore it to a wedding reception and received so many compliments!

reviews.title: Custom stitching perfection
reviews.comment: Muskan's Stitching's customized measurements fit me like a glove without needing a single alteration. The fabric feels luxurious and breathable.
